info.title: ShopFloor Twin MES API
info.description: API of the MES (Phases 4 and 5): equipment with current state, state intervals, telemetry series, shift totals, the plant clock, OEE per hour and shift, shift instances, reason codes, downtime records and the loss Pareto; one write, downtime coding (#121), with its audit. No authentication yet (Phase 7): writes are guarded (ADR-0023: Origin of this host, Sec-Fetch-Site, application/json, 16 KiB, a global rate limit, MES_WRITES=off answers 405) and audited as unauthenticated; bound to loopback by default. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details. Push: WebSocket at /api/v1/ws (see docs/api/realtime.md).

type.description: Always about:blank: the status says it all

Problem.description: An error (RFC 9457 problem details), served as application/problem+json

get.summary: OEE of an equipment or work center per hour or shift bucket
get.description: Computed on read (ADR-0021): availability, performance, quality and OEE as exact fractions and four-decimal strings, with inputs, totals and losses. A work center sums its machines' inputs. Shift buckets are whole shifts; no-shift stretches are clipped to the range. `final` once nothing that can still arrive changes the bucket.

Epoch: the one given, else the newest with data (one for all machines of a work center).

put.summary: Codes one downtime record: replaces its codings (splits, comment, who)
put.description: Each segment is a time range [from, to) inside the record with an active reason (not UNCODED); segments must not overlap; an empty list clears the codings. Time without a coding keeps the auto reason. `version` is the record’s `version` as read: it belongs to the coding set of the (equipment, epoch), and a mismatch is 409. `codedBy` is free text, recorded as unauthenticated. Audited; reasons never change OEE, only the Pareto and the reason view. Writes need an Origin of this host (or allowlisted), `Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin` when sent, and application/json (ADR-0023).

to.description: End (exclusive), inside the record (an open one: up to its watermark)

reason.description: An active reason code id, not UNCODED

segments.description: Non-overlapping ranges inside the record; empty clears its codings. A split is two

codedBy.description: Who codes, as typed: recorded as unauthenticated

version.description: The record's `version` as read: 409 when the set moved on
